title_en: Fall 2026 Blue Lighthouse Donation Scholarship: Second Round of New Recipient Selection
summary: Undergraduate students of Korean nationality who are currently enrolled (excluding those on leave of absence in Fall 2026) may apply for the Blue Lighthouse (푸른등대) Donation Scholarship, a living-expense scholarship of KRW 2,000,000 per person for the Fall 2026 semester. Students must apply directly on the Korea Student Aid Foundation website (www.kosaf.go.kr) between 09:00 on Thursday, 22 October 2026 and 18:00 on Thursday, 12 November 2026.
applies_to: Undergraduate students of Korean nationality who are currently enrolled at the university, excluding students on leave of absence in the Fall 2026 semester (2026학년도 2학기). Application is voluntary; detailed eligibility requirements for each scholarship are set out in Attachment 1, which was not included in the text provided.

dates.what: Application period (online, Korea Student Aid Foundation website)
dates.when: From 09:00 on Thursday, 22 October 2026 to 18:00 on Thursday, 12 November 2026

conditions: Only students of Korean nationality are eligible.
Only enrolled undergraduate students are eligible.
Students on leave of absence in the Fall 2026 semester are not eligible.
Each scholarship has further detailed requirements set out in Attachment 1, the Donation Scholarship Program Business Plan.
Students must apply in person on the Korea Student Aid Foundation website; applications must be made by the student directly.
The scholarship is a living-expense scholarship of KRW 2,000,000 per person and covers one semester (Fall 2026) only.
steps: Read Attachment 1, the Donation Scholarship Program Business Plan ([붙임1] 기부장학사업 사업계획서), to check the detailed requirements of each scholarship (this attachment was not included in the text provided and was not read).
Go to the Korea Student Aid Foundation website (www.kosaf.go.kr) and submit your application yourself between 09:00 on 22 October 2026 and 18:00 on 12 November 2026.
For questions, contact the Korea Student Aid Foundation counselling centre; the contact details are given in the original notice.
translation:
Fall 2026 Blue Lighthouse (푸른등대) Donation Scholarship: Second Selection of New Scholarship Recipients

A. Eligibility: Undergraduate students of Korean nationality currently enrolled at the university (excluding students on leave of absence in the Fall 2026 semester)
※ For the detailed requirements of each scholarship, refer to [Attachment 1] Donation Scholarship Program Business Plan ([붙임1] 기부장학사업 사업계획서). (This attachment was not included in the text provided and was not read.)

B. Support: Living-expense scholarship of KRW 2,000,000 per person

C. Support period: One semester (Fall 2026)

D. Application period: 22 October 2026 (Thursday), 09:00 to 12 November 2026 (Thursday), 18:00

E. How to apply: Students apply directly on the Korea Student Aid Foundation website (www.kosaf.go.kr)

F. Enquiries: Korea Student Aid Foundation counselling centre (contact details are given in the original notice)
